description: Ask a question about ~alter in plain words and get the answer the ~alter website gives, from the same list of questions and answers its FAQ page shows. Use it to learn what ~alter is, who it is for and how a person stays in charge of their own record, before you explain any of it to someone. Returns the closest answer with its full wording and links, up to five near matches, and, when nothing matches, the topics it can answer about. No model writes the answer, and neither the question nor the caller is kept. Free L0, no authentication required.
